speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your headache in detail, including its location, severity, and any associated symptoms like nausea or visual changes.

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old woman. The patient reports a 3-week history of headache and progressively worsening vision. She has not noticed any other symptoms, including no recent weight changes, no fevers, no night sweats, and no pain elsewhere in the body.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Angiitis of the Central Nervous System (PACNS). The patient's age, 3-week history of headache, and progressively worsening vision without other systemic symptoms (fever, weight loss, night sweats) are highly suggestive of this diagnosis. I request the following tests to confirm: CSF Analysis (looking for elevated protein and pleocytosis) and MRI Brain with contrast to evaluate for parenchymal inflammation.
